an10.149:1.1: uppādetabbañca vo bhikkhave dhammaṃ desissāmi na uppādetabbañca
an10.149:1.2: taṃ suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasikarotha bhāsissāmīti. evaṃ bhanteti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ. bhagavā etadavoca
an10.149:1.3: katamo ca bhikkhave na uppādetabbo dhammo
an10.149:1.5: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave na uppādetabbo dhammo.
